【Fortune/Lucrétia D'Argento】(27)

The heiress to the prestigious D'Argento family, known for their sophisticated arms manufacturing business within the Wiarachia Empire. Keenly aware of the limitations imposed by their trade agreement, which restricts their dealings within the empire, Lucretia operates under the codename "Fortune" to clandestinely sell arms to other nations.

props.name: Fortune
props.notes_text:
• Calm yet calculated

Despite her calm and gentle demeanor, she is without a doubt, a strict businesswoman. She Navigate the world of business under a facade of kindness and occasional playfulness, while maintaining a cold and efficient demeanor when it comes to her dealing.

  • Life of Luxuries

Beyond her business dealing, Lucrétia lives a life of opulence and sophistication. She do enjoys indulging herself in the pleasure of a good foods or accomodations. She likes collecting Fine Arts and would also loan them to museums.

  • Appreciation of Arts

Lucrétia is an avid enjoyers of fine arts, Like most refined lady, she enjoys the beauty of arts, but even more beyond its beauty,  Lucrétia is more captivated by the message and personality of the artist bleeding through each masterpiece, these thoughts are what keeping her mind pondering, a sentiments which she enjoys

  • Fame, the crow

Fame is a crow that Lucrétia trained to act as her messenger.

0.passive_description:
Permanently increase your maximum Hit Points and maximum Mind Points by 5 and your maximum inventory by 2

Base Quirk: Survivor

1.passive_description: Once before the next rest, you may perform an additional action on your turn during a conflict scene. This action must be used to perform the Equipment, Hinder, or Inventory action.

2.passive_description: Once before the next rest, after making an initiative Check as leader or a Check to examine someone or something, the target may add a bonus of +4 to the result of the Check.

3.passive_description: When you spend Inventory Points, you spend 1 less Inventory Point (minimum 1).

0.description:
After you rest in an area where commerce is possible, you gain 【SL + 1】 Trade Points.
You may never have more than 【SL + 3】 Trade Points


During a non-conflict scene, you may spend 2 Trade Points to choose one option:

  • You create a material or rare item approved by the Game Master whose value is equal toor lower than 【your level, multiplied by 40】 
  • You create an NPC that lives nearby and explain their occupation as well as how you met them, then the Game Master tells you what they require in exchange for their services.

1.description: When you or another Player Character spend 【SL + 2】 or fewer Inventory Points, you may spend 1 Trade Point to ignore that cost.

2.description: When you or an ally who is able to hear and understand you perform a Check to examine a creature, item, or location, you may spend 1 Trade Point to grant a bonus equal to 6 to the Result of that Check.

3.description: Once per session, when you help an NPC or community defeat greed and corruption, improve their quality of life, or coexist with other creatures, if you have acquired the Winds of Trade Skill, you gain 1 Trade Points.

4.description: Choose any number of creatures you can see: each of them suffers 【30 + half your level】dark damage of then and suffers weak.

5.description: You gain a bonus equal to 4 to all Accuracy Checks with ranged weapons.

6.description:
When you create a potion that restores a single creature's HP and/or MP, you may have it affect up to 2 additional creatures.

If you do, the potion only restores half the normal amount of HP and MP to each creature.

7.description:
When you perform the Guard action, if you choose not to provide cover to another
creature, you may choose one option: the next ranged attack you perform before the
end of the current scene will deal 【SL × 2】 extra damage; or you may immediately
perform a free attack with a bow or firearm you have equipped, treating your High Roll
(HR) as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.

8.description:
When you perform a ranged attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one:

  • The attack gains multi (2)
  •  Increase the attack's multi property by one, up to a maximum of multi (3).

9.description:
When you hit one or more targets with a ranged attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option:

  • Inflict shaken on each target hit by the attack
  • Inflict slow on each target hit by the attack
  • Each target hit by the attack loses 10 Mind Points.

10.description:
When you create a potion or magisphere whose effects restore HP and/or MP, each restored amount is increased by 25.

When you create an elemental shard, potion or magisphere that deals damage, that item deals 5 extra damage.

11.description:
When you successfully hit one or more targets with an attack, you may spend 2
Inventory Points to produce a special infusion and apply the corresponding effect to
that attack (if the attack had the multi property, apply the effects of the infusion to
each target).


You cannot apply more than one infusion to the same attack; producing and using an
infusion are both part of the action you used to attack with the weapon.

12.description:
You may perform the Inventory action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a magitech armament and destroy any magitech armament you previously created. Whenever you create a magitech armament:

  • it's damage is 【HR+12】Physical
  • Choose a Category for it among arcane, brawling, firearm, heavy, spear, or sword
  • Choose a damage type: Air, Bolt, Fire or Ice
  • Choose whether it is a melee or ranged weapon
  • Choose an Accuracy formula between【DEX + INS】+1 and 【INS + MIG】+1 for it.
  • The armament will always occupy both hand slots.

Additionally, whenever you create a magitech armament, you may immediately equip it and perform a free attack with it.

13.description: You recover 4 Inventory Points after each travel roll .

14.description: As long as you have no shields and no martial armor equipped, your Defense score is increased by 1.
